verdict.rationale: The only evidence of published pricing is a community remark about a 20% discount off "the website prices" through a quarterly commit negotiated with an account manager. That implies list prices exist but that real costs depend on sales negotiation. Another large customer cites lack of billing transparency as a reason for leaving, and a third notes negotiated rates for serverless, so predicting costs without sales is weakly supported. Missing for 10: a first-party per-signal pricing page in the evidence, documentation of pricing units per signal (hosts, spans, logs, custom metrics), a cost estimator or calculator, and independent confirmation that list prices predict actual bills.
